meaning: Exhaustively verify each Boolean edge table satisfies reflexivity and transitivity and refute symmetry/Euclideanness with the root-left edges. The left self-loop preserves every predicate. Use a negated atom to refute root language collapse, restrict full collapse to that domain for its refutation, and use reflexivity to refute necessary collapse. Give left/root witnesses for independent contingency and refute possibility entails actuality with the first atom.
